cases.test_case_title: Set partner-type contract duration and apply a mid-term list price update after notice
cases.preconditions: Partner type is reseller or direct customer; a contract record can store start and end dates; a notice period for list-price updates can be configured.
cases.coverage_focus: Contract duration by partner type and mid-term list price update with notice

steps.detailed_test_step: Set a reseller contract duration between 1 and 3 years and store the agreed start and end dates.
steps.expected_result: Reseller contract duration is accepted and the contract record stores the agreed start and end dates reflecting the selected duration.

steps.detailed_test_step: Set a direct customer contract duration up to 5 years and store the agreed start and end dates.
steps.test_data: Direct customer; duration up to 5 years
steps.expected_result: Direct customer contract duration is accepted up to 5 years and dates are stored on the contract record.

steps.detailed_test_step: Update the list price on the active contract and start the configured notice period, notifying the partner of the updated price file.
steps.expected_result: List price on the active contract can be updated; the partner receives notification of the updated price file at the start of the notice period.

steps.detailed_test_step: Wait until the configured notice period has elapsed from notification, then confirm the updated pricing is effective.
steps.expected_result: Updated pricing is not effective until the configured notice period has elapsed from notification; after that it is effective.

cases.test_case_title: Reject contract duration outside the agreed reseller or direct-customer range
cases.preconditions: Partner type is reseller or direct customer; duration limits in the stories are in force (reseller 1 to 3 years; direct customer up to 5 years).
cases.coverage_focus: Contract duration by partner type and mid-term list price update with notice

steps.detailed_test_step: Attempt to set a reseller contract duration outside 1 to 3 years.
steps.expected_result: Reseller contract duration cannot be set outside 1 to 3 years.

steps.detailed_test_step: Attempt to set a direct customer contract duration above 5 years.
steps.expected_result: Direct customer contract duration cannot be set above 5 years.

steps.detailed_test_step: Confirm a list-price update on an active contract is not treated as effective before the notice period elapses.
steps.expected_result: Updated pricing is not effective until the configured notice period has elapsed from notification.

cases.test_case_title: Keep account planning in Zinfi and store only required visibility data in CRM
cases.preconditions: Account planning (creation, approval) is performed in Zinfi; Dynamics 365 CRM is used only for CRM-side visibility data points.
cases.coverage_focus: Account-planning data points in CRM with full planning in Zinfi

steps.detailed_test_step: Perform account-planning creation and approval in Zinfi.
steps.expected_result: Account planning workflow (creation, approval) is performed in Zinfi, not CRM.

steps.detailed_test_step: Confirm Dynamics 365 CRM stores only the data points required for CRM-side visibility.
steps.expected_result: CRM stores only the data points confirmed as required for CRM visibility.

cases.test_case_title: Do not run account-planning creation and approval in CRM
cases.preconditions: Account planning workflow is defined as performed in Zinfi, not CRM.
cases.coverage_focus: Account-planning data points in CRM with full planning in Zinfi

steps.detailed_test_step: Attempt to perform account-planning creation and approval in Dynamics 365 CRM instead of Zinfi.
steps.expected_result: Account planning workflow (creation, approval) is not performed in CRM.

cases.test_case_title: Record authorized product terms on the sales-partner contract and share the finalized contract in Zinfi
cases.preconditions: A sales-partner contract can be recorded; internal approval can complete before partner visibility in Zinfi.
cases.coverage_focus: Sales-partner contract terms and partner visibility of the finalized contract in Zinfi

steps.detailed_test_step: Record on the contract the product categories or items the partner is authorized to distribute, plus discount and rebate terms.
steps.expected_result: Contract record stores authorized product categories/items and discount and rebate terms, which may vary by product group or specific material.

steps.detailed_test_step: Store the resulting list-price-derived pricing used for quotations on the contract record.
steps.expected_result: Contract record stores the resulting list-price-derived pricing used for quotations.

steps.detailed_test_step: After internal approval, make the finalized contract visible to the partner in Zinfi.
steps.expected_result: Finalized contract is made visible to the partner in Zinfi after internal approval.

steps.detailed_test_step: As the partner, view the contract discount, rebate, and product-category terms in Zinfi.
steps.expected_result: Partner can view the contract's discount, rebate, and product-category terms through Zinfi.

cases.test_case_title: Do not show the contract to the partner in Zinfi before internal approval
cases.preconditions: A sales-partner contract exists that has not completed internal approval.
cases.coverage_focus: Sales-partner contract terms and partner visibility of the finalized contract in Zinfi

steps.detailed_test_step: Attempt to view the contract in Zinfi before internal approval is complete.
steps.expected_result: Finalized contract is not made visible to the partner in Zinfi before internal approval.

cases.business_process: Partner Onboarding & Enablement with Partner data synchronization
cases.test_case_title: Sync approved partner account and contact from Zinfi to CRM after onboarding is finalized
cases.preconditions: Partner onboarding in Zinfi can reach Approved (due diligence, required training, and contract signature complete).
cases.coverage_focus: Approved partner sync from Zinfi to Dynamics 365 CRM with linked account numbers

steps.detailed_test_step: Set Zinfi onboarding status to Approved for a partner whose due diligence, required training, and contract signature are complete.
steps.expected_result: Approved partner is eligible to sync to Dynamics 365 CRM.

steps.detailed_test_step: Sync the approved partner from Zinfi to Dynamics 365 CRM.
steps.expected_result: Approved partner triggers creation of an account record and associated contact record in CRM.

steps.detailed_test_step: Confirm the partner account number in Zinfi is linked to the corresponding CRM account number.
steps.expected_result: Partner account number in Zinfi is linked to the corresponding CRM account number.

cases.business_process: Partner Onboarding & Enablement with Partner data synchronization
cases.test_case_title: Do not create a CRM partner record before Zinfi onboarding status is Approved
cases.preconditions: A partner exists in Zinfi whose onboarding status is not Approved.
cases.coverage_focus: Approved partner sync from Zinfi to Dynamics 365 CRM with linked account numbers

steps.detailed_test_step: Attempt to create the partner record in Dynamics 365 CRM while Zinfi onboarding status is not Approved.
steps.expected_result: Partner record is not created in CRM until Zinfi onboarding status is Approved.

cases.business_process: Partner Data Available in CRM & synchronization with FnO
cases.test_case_title: Sync partner visibility to one legal entity with a single owner and legal-entity-wide read access
cases.preconditions: A partner record can be synced from a given region; CRM users can be logged into the corresponding legal entity or a different legal entity.
cases.coverage_focus: Legal-entity scoped partner visibility, single owner, and default read-only partner record

steps.detailed_test_step: Sync a partner record created from a given region into the corresponding CRM legal entity.
steps.expected_result: Partner record is synced to and visible only in the corresponding CRM legal entity; one partner maps to exactly one legal entity for the current scope.

steps.detailed_test_step: Confirm the synced partner record has exactly one owner (user or team) assigned on sync.
steps.test_data: Owner is the approving channel/account manager or team
steps.expected_result: Partner record has exactly one owner (user or team) assigned on sync.

steps.detailed_test_step: As an authenticated CRM user within the partner's legal entity, view the partner record.
steps.expected_result: Any authenticated CRM user within the partner's legal entity can view the record.

steps.detailed_test_step: Immediately after sync, confirm partner record fields are non-editable for CRM users.
steps.expected_result: Partner record fields are non-editable for all CRM users immediately after sync.

cases.business_process: Partner Data Available in CRM & synchronization with FnO
cases.test_case_title: Hide the partner from other legal entities and block unapproved edits including in-place location changes
cases.preconditions: A partner record is synced to one legal entity; a CRM user can log into a different legal entity; a non-owner user is available.
cases.coverage_focus: Legal-entity scoped partner visibility, single owner, and default read-only partner record

steps.detailed_test_step: Log into a different legal entity than the partner's originating legal entity and attempt to view the partner record.
steps.expected_result: Users logged into a different legal entity cannot see the partner record.

steps.detailed_test_step: As a user who is not the assigned owner, attempt to edit the partner record.
steps.expected_result: Only the assigned owner (or an approved exception) can edit the record.

steps.detailed_test_step: Attempt to add a new partner location or warehouse by editing the existing partner record.
steps.expected_result: Adding a new partner location/warehouse is treated as a new record, not an edit to the existing partner record.

steps.detailed_test_step: Attempt to grant the record owner open edit rights without an approval flow.
steps.expected_result: Any future edit capability for the record owner is gated behind an approval flow (not direct open edit).

cases.test_case_title: Synchronize partner training completion status from Zinfi to CRM
cases.preconditions: Training status values are recorded in Zinfi; a CRM partner record exists to receive status.
cases.coverage_focus: Training status sync to CRM without storing training content

steps.detailed_test_step: Record training status values in Zinfi and synchronize them to the training status field on the CRM partner record.
steps.expected_result: Training status values recorded in Zinfi are synchronized to a training status field on the CRM partner record.

cases.test_case_title: Do not store training content or course detail in CRM
cases.preconditions: Training status can be synchronized; CRM is not the learning management system.
cases.coverage_focus: Training status sync to CRM without storing training content

steps.detailed_test_step: Inspect the CRM partner record after training status sync for training content or course detail.
steps.expected_result: CRM does not store training content or course detail, only status.

cases.test_case_title: Create a CRM lead, distribute it to the partner in Zinfi, and sync progress back for CRM reporting
cases.preconditions: A lead can be created in Dynamics 365 CRM by sales or marketing and assigned to a partner in Zinfi.
cases.coverage_focus: CRM-to-Zinfi lead distribution with status sync-back and close reporting

steps.detailed_test_step: Create a lead in Dynamics 365 CRM by sales or marketing and synchronize it to Zinfi for the assigned partner.
steps.step_owner: Heartstream sales or marketing team member
steps.expected_result: Lead created in CRM by sales or marketing is synchronized to Zinfi and visible to the assigned partner.

steps.detailed_test_step: As the partner, update lead progress or status in Zinfi and confirm the update synchronizes back to CRM.
steps.expected_result: Lead progress/status updates made by the partner in Zinfi are synchronized back to CRM.

steps.detailed_test_step: Use CRM reporting to show whether the distributed lead was closed and the outcome.
steps.step_owner: Heartstream sales or marketing team member
steps.expected_result: CRM reporting can show whether a distributed lead was closed and the outcome.

cases.test_case_title: Do not leave a CRM-created lead invisible to the assigned partner in Zinfi
cases.preconditions: A lead is created in Dynamics 365 CRM for an assigned partner.
cases.coverage_focus: CRM-to-Zinfi lead distribution with status sync-back and close reporting

steps.detailed_test_step: Create a lead in CRM for an assigned partner and verify it is visible to that partner in Zinfi; if it is not visible, the distribution failed.
steps.step_owner: Heartstream sales or marketing team member
steps.expected_result: Lead created in CRM is synchronized to Zinfi and visible to the assigned partner; a lead that remains invisible to the assigned partner does not meet the story.

cases.test_case_title: Account manager creates a field lead in CRM that follows the same distribution as marketing-sourced leads
cases.preconditions: Account managers can create lead records directly in CRM; marketing-sourced lead distribution and synchronization are in place.
cases.coverage_focus: Account-manager and partner-originated lead capture with CRM/Zinfi sync

steps.detailed_test_step: As an account manager, create a new lead record directly in CRM.
steps.expected_result: Account manager can create a new lead record directly in CRM.

steps.detailed_test_step: Confirm the self-created lead follows the same distribution and synchronization process as marketing-sourced leads.
steps.expected_result: Self-created leads follow the same distribution and synchronization process as marketing-sourced leads.

cases.test_case_title: Partner registers an independently generated lead in Zinfi without a Heartstream-assigned source
cases.preconditions: Partner can create a lead in Zinfi; CRM visibility of partner-created leads is in scope.
cases.coverage_focus: Account-manager and partner-originated lead capture with CRM/Zinfi sync

steps.detailed_test_step: As a partner, create a new lead record in Zinfi without a Heartstream-assigned source.
steps.expected_result: Partner can create a new lead record in Zinfi without a Heartstream-assigned source.

steps.detailed_test_step: Confirm the partner-created lead is synchronized to CRM for visibility.
steps.expected_result: Partner-created lead is synchronized to CRM for visibility.

cases.test_case_title: Share opportunity notes globally, configure pipeline stages, and flag registered deals by product category
cases.preconditions: An opportunity can be collaborated on in Zinfi and CRM; a global opportunity pipeline can be configured for phase 1; product/solution category can be selected on the opportunity.
cases.coverage_focus: Shared opportunity notes, global stages, and deal-registration by product category

steps.detailed_test_step: Add notes to an opportunity as a partner in Zinfi and as a Heartstream user in CRM, and log customer-facing communication from either party.
steps.step_owner: partner or Heartstream team member collaborating on an opportunity
steps.expected_result: Notes added by a partner in Zinfi are visible to Heartstream users in CRM and vice versa; customer-facing communication logged by either party is visible to the other party on the same opportunity record.

steps.detailed_test_step: Configure a globally standardized set of opportunity stages for phase 1 and confirm stage names and count can be modified via configuration without custom development.
steps.test_data: Phase 1; no per-region stage variation at launch
steps.expected_result: Opportunity pipeline stages are configured globally for phase 1; stage names and count can be modified via configuration without custom development.

steps.detailed_test_step: Capture mandatory information required by a stage before progressing to the next stage.
steps.expected_result: Each stage can require mandatory information to be captured before the user can progress to the next stage.

steps.detailed_test_step: Select a product/solution category configured as a registered-deal category on the opportunity.
steps.expected_result: Opportunity records a product/solution category selection; selecting a registered-deal category applies the single-partner deal-registration restriction.

steps.detailed_test_step: Select a product/solution category not configured for deal registration.
steps.test_data: Category not configured for deal registration
steps.expected_result: Selecting a category not configured for deal registration allows multiple partners on the same opportunity.

cases.test_case_title: Block a second partner from registering a deal against a customer with an active registered deal
cases.preconditions: A customer already has an active registered deal; a second partner attempts deal registration.
cases.coverage_focus: Shared opportunity notes, global stages, and deal-registration by product category

steps.detailed_test_step: Attempt to register a deal against a customer that already has an active registered deal.
steps.test_data: Customer with an active registered deal
steps.expected_result: Attempting to register a deal against a customer that already has an active registered deal returns a blocking notification.

steps.detailed_test_step: Confirm the blocking check applies at deal registration (and, for large/professional deals, at opportunity creation), not only at deal conversion.
steps.expected_result: The blocking check applies at deal registration (and, for large/professional deals, at opportunity creation) rather than only at deal conversion.

cases.test_case_title: Derive quote pricing from the partner contract and allow in-contract discounts without extra approval
cases.preconditions: The partner has an active contract; a quote can be linked to an opportunity and through it to the contracted partner.
cases.coverage_focus: Contract-derived quote pricing, tiered extra-discount approval, and revision re-trigger rules

steps.detailed_test_step: Create a quote linked to the opportunity and the contracted partner, and confirm quote line pricing defaults to the partner's active contract.
steps.step_owner: partner or sales user creating a quote
steps.expected_result: Quote line pricing defaults to the price derived from the partner's active contract; quote is linked to the opportunity and, through it, to the contracted partner.

steps.detailed_test_step: Apply a discount that remains within the contracted terms.
steps.step_owner: sales or partner user requesting a discount beyond the contracted price
steps.expected_result: Discount within the contracted terms requires no additional approval.

steps.detailed_test_step: Create a quote associated with a shell/placeholder opportunity rather than a new full opportunity.
steps.step_owner: sales or partner user quoting a single low-value item
steps.expected_result: A quote can be created and associated with a shell/placeholder opportunity rather than requiring a new full opportunity each time.

cases.test_case_title: Route extra-contract discount through tiered approval and re-trigger approval on price or configuration revision
cases.preconditions: An unconfirmed quote or order exists; configured discount thresholds for account manager, regional sales director, and head of sales are in force as stated in the story.
cases.coverage_focus: Contract-derived quote pricing, tiered extra-discount approval, and revision re-trigger rules

steps.detailed_test_step: Request a discount above contract up to the configured account-manager threshold.
steps.step_owner: sales or partner user requesting a discount beyond the contracted price
steps.expected_result: Discount above contract up to a configured threshold requires account manager approval.

steps.detailed_test_step: Request a discount above the next threshold and then above the highest threshold.
steps.step_owner: sales or partner user requesting a discount beyond the contracted price
steps.expected_result: Discount above the next threshold requires regional sales director approval; discount above the highest threshold requires head of sales approval as stated in the story.

steps.detailed_test_step: Edit price or product configuration on an unconfirmed quote or order.
steps.expected_result: Editing price or product configuration on an unconfirmed quote/order re-triggers the approval workflow.

steps.detailed_test_step: Edit only the requested delivery date on an unconfirmed quote or order.
steps.expected_result: Editing only the requested delivery date on an unconfirmed quote/order does not re-trigger approval.

steps.detailed_test_step: Attempt a pricing or configuration revision after sales order confirmation.
steps.expected_result: Revisions are only permitted prior to sales order confirmation.

cases.business_process: Order Capture / Management & Order processing by order sync between F&O and CRM

steps.detailed_test_step: Transmit the confirmed sales order from CRM to the F&O system for fulfillment.
steps.expected_result: Confirmed sales order is transmitted from CRM to the F&O system for fulfillment.

cases.business_process: Order Capture / Management & Order processing by order sync between F&O and CRM
cases.test_case_title: Block conversion of a quote that is not approved and block fulfillment start without Requested Delivery Date
cases.preconditions: A quote that is not approved exists; a sales order can be missing Requested Delivery Date.

steps.detailed_test_step: Attempt to convert a quote that is not approved into a confirmed sales order.
steps.expected_result: Only an approved quote can be converted into a confirmed sales order.

steps.detailed_test_step: Attempt to start fulfillment on a sales order that has no Requested Delivery Date.
steps.step_owner: partner converting a quote to an order
steps.expected_result: Requested Delivery Date is a mandatory field on the sales order prior to fulfillment start.

cases.test_case_title: Update order status from ERP in CRM and Zinfi and provide required shipment documents for the destination region
cases.preconditions: Status changes can be received from the ERP/supply chain system; destination region document requirements can be configured.

steps.expected_result: System identifies the required document set for the shipment's destination region; required documents are made available to the partner alongside the shipment confirmation; document requirements vary by region and can be configured accordingly.

cases.test_case_title: Block cancellation and edit after the order reaches the configured lock status
cases.preconditions: A sales order can reach the configured lock status from ERP/supply chain status changes.

steps.detailed_test_step: Advance the order to the configured lock status, then attempt cancellation or edit in the application.

steps.expected_result: Once the order reaches the configured lock status, cancellation and edit actions are blocked in the application.

steps.detailed_test_step: Submit a cancellation or edit request after the lock status.
steps.step_owner: supply chain or order management stakeholder
steps.expected_result: Attempted cancellation/edit requests after the lock status are rejected.

steps.expected_result: Service contract record stores SLA timelines/agreements applicable to the partner.

steps.detailed_test_step: Link a multi-year post-warranty service contract to specific device serial numbers.

cases.test_case_title: Create an install base record at delivery for serialized hardware and retain original order and ship-to
cases.preconditions: Serialized hardware has a confirmed serial number; the agreed trigger is delivery preferred as stated in the story (exact trigger per product type pending DQ-003).

steps.detailed_test_step: Attempt to edit the install base record directly as the partner.

cases.test_case_title: Partner raises a case escalation in Zinfi that synchronizes to CRM for triage
